response.sql: SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) as avg_rebrate, SUM(f.rebtotal) as total_rebate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff value 0.0009 is inclusive: feerate >= 0.0009 qualifies as 'high-rate'

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is exclusive—only feerate > 0.0009 (strictly greater than 0.0009) counts as high-rate
